units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:3:8">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᶜ</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:15">Deut. VII, 15</cite>) <he>כל חלי זה ר׳</he> ‘every disease’, this means ambition; (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:8">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> <he>זו עין</he>). Y. Sabb. l. c. (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 28:48">Deut. XXVIII, 48</cite>) <he>ונתן … זה ר׳</he> ‘he will put an iron yoke on thy neck’, that is greed.
